CustomField.description: How long, in milliseconds, AIAgentManager waits for an AI provider callout before treating it as failed. Applies to every AI Model Configuration. Required - a blank value fails every AI message.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: 1 - 120000 (the Apex callout limit). Must be set - a blank value fails every AI message.
CustomField.label: Callout Timeout Milliseconds
